} title="Edit Instructions" description="Review and modify the instructions you just created" onClick={onEditInstructions} /> } title="Add New Instructions" description={`Create different instructions for "${savedItemName}"`} onClick={onAddNewInstructions} variant="primary" /> } title="Create New Item" description="Start fresh with a different item" onClick={onCreateNewItem} />
